doi_code: PENDING (Zenodo via GitHub release; requires team institutional account)
crs: EPSG:25831 (ETRS89 / UTM 31N) internal; outputs reprojected to EPSG:4326 for web map

street_tree_inventory.description: Barcelona street-tree inventory (arbrat viari); 145,257 trees, 40,444 Platanus

population_padro_2026.description: Municipal population register (Padro) 2026 by census section; 1,729,963 residents, 1,068 sections

census_section_polygons.description: Administrative-unit polygons; SEC_CENS rows used as census sections

allergen_layers.description: Phase-5 cell-grain product (494 cells): source/exposure/deprivation layers

age_register_padro_2026.description: Padro 2026 population by census section x 5-year age band; denominator for the vulnerability layer and the Rx calibration

catsalut_respiratory_rx.description: CatSalut respiratory prescriptions (BCN ciutat, 2024-25) by age x sex x ATC class (R01 nasal, R03 obstructive, R06 antihistamine). Used ONLY for the exploratory Rx calibration (src/rx_calibration.py); city-wide by age, not spatial.

section_priority_parquet.description: Section-grain priority (1,068 sections) with geometry; the deployment data product

street_removal_actions.description: Per-street Platanus worklist for top-60 sections; ACTION layer (no priority column)

street_removal_points.description: Plane-tree points (WGS84) for top sections; QA / map layer

deployment_map.description: Self-contained interactive map (section/cell toggle, street worklists). Presentation aid, not a maintained service.

section_enrich.description: Augmentation layer: cross-grain corroboration verdict (CORROBORATED/ARTIFACT/UNDERRATED/minor) + monoculture share + Shannon diversity + thermal heat-risk flag, per section. Presentation derivation over Phase 1-4 outputs (no new ingestion).

section_enrich_summary.description: Enrichment summary + Montjuic correctness gate (grain Spearman 0.467; #1 section = ARTIFACT).

rx_calibration.description: EXPLORATORY (not a pre-registered test): literature allergy age weights vs real CatSalut respiratory prescriptions. Finding: DIVERGES (real per-capita allergy Rx peaks 65+, literature peaks 20-44; shape Spearman -0.40). JSON sibling: rx_calibration.json.

augmentation_note.description: Design + honesty record for the corroboration/co-benefit/thermal augmentation and the Rx finding.

planner_app.description: Self-contained Leaflet planner app (priority/corroboration/archetype/hotspot/400m layers, objective + euro budget planner, marginal-relief curve, street worklists). Presentation aid; loads app_data.js. Not a maintained service.

planner_app_data.description: Inlined data bundle for planner.html (window.PLANNER_DATA): sections GeoJSON with priority + enrichment + per-objective scores, 400m cells, meta. Regenerated by scripts/build_app_data.py.
